notes.title: important update
notes.content:
hey there, it's Dusky, uhh, if you can believe me I did not know people were posting on the forums.

Yeah the demo is broken, been broken for a while, currently working on fixing that!

Very sorry for the wait. Should be fixed by the end of the year, will feature some new things too - nothing crazy, but how do some new music tracks and character animations sound?



I made a post on Twitter that goes a little more in depth on my recent identity crisis/brush with death/all that fun stuff.

https://x.com/H4voc_Studios/status/1953353621623419002

I HIGHLY recommend, if you are still here, you read that if you read anything from me.



Thank you!





(they forced me to upload a cover image so look at our new logo i guess)
